title: Trajectory-Based Optimization for Air Traffic Control in the Terminal Maneuvering Area
summary: We present a trajectory-based optimization framework for arrival sequencing and scheduling in the terminal maneuvering area (TMA). Unlike node-link scheduling models that reduce trajectories to time-delay variables, the proposed method computes implementable per-aircraft speed profiles and path extensions that achieve required landing separation through terminal air traffic control actions.
